what_happened: Kernel-evaluated probe settled option 3 in one elaboration pass: 10 decide-level results, zero sorries, standard axioms. posAtFull measured against posAt/liveAt at five landed certificates.

Task description's premise -- 'full labels make posAt a singleton so no junk position could exist' -- is refuted as stated: posAtFull Fixture.cert (-1) is a 2-element set unequal to liveAt (-1), so a dead full-label position exists.
